lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Hg4N4O12 (reduced formula CeHg2(NO3)2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral CeN6 and HgN6 environments, alongside tetrahedral HgO4 units, with Hg centers showing mixed N/O coordination. The connectivity forms a three-dimensional network, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Hg octahedra and Hg tetrahedra, plus edge-sharing between Ce octahedra.
